references.text: Jaffa (Joppa) is mentioned as the port city where timber from Lebanon was shipped for temple construction, the same city bordering Dan's inheritance.
Jonah fled to Jaffa (Joppa) to board a ship for Tarshish, that same coastal city mentioned here at Dan's boundary.
Joppa (Jaffa) is the place where Peter raised Tabitha from the dead, the same coastal city marking the border of Dan's inheritance.
Peter was in Joppa (Jaffa) when he received the vision about unclean animals, the city mentioned here as a boundary point.
Jaffa is again mentioned as the port city for timber from Lebanon during the rebuilding of the temple after the exile.
